title: Post game
note: The outro of about 3 s, one of the three loud moments that end a round (the target page pages/suit-final, section 10): the End phase fades to this screen (0.4 s; a cut under reduced motion), plays one sound for the win and one for the loss (the cops' end with a siren, m8 §6), routes no voice (#213) and returns everyone to the ship after 3 s (#212). Nobody hears anybody and no text says so. No input, so no control and no focus. The loud part is only the band (or, for the cops, the whole screen); the lines under it are quiet text. Open: whether the end reveals who was human, and whether it shows the points (today it names only the winner).

states.label: Прибульці перемогли
states.note: Every task done before the timer and the cops (the target's frame 10a): the accent band.

states.label: Час вийшов
states.note: The timer ran out with the tasks unfinished (frame 10b): the danger band.

states.label: Копи приїхали
states.note: The cops' minute ran out (frame 10c), the loudest end: the whole screen in the danger colour, the band the same colour, every line in the danger ink.

nodes.name: Night
nodes.note: Opaque, the whole screen: the full screens' base ground, ToyBackdropAlert (the danger colour) for the cops' end. It fades in over 0.4 s when the End phase starts (a cut under reduced motion). The texts are its children, so they sit on it (the danger ink needs the danger ground).

children.name: Band
children.note: The loud band across the whole width, 300 px down and 315 tall (the target's 200 and 210 x 1.5): the accent when the aliens won, the danger colour when the humans did; on the cops' danger ground it is the same colour, so the title stands on the whole screen.

children.name: Title
children.note: How the party ended, the same for every player, in Unbounded at the hero size: end.title.party in the accent ink, end.title.time_up or end.title.busted in the danger ink. The target sets the cops' title in capitals and larger (210 px); the pack's hero is 126 px and has no capitals (open, see the PR).

children.name: Lines
children.note: Under the band, 57 px below it (the target's 450 - 410 = 40 x 1.5 less the title's leading): who won, then why. Quiet text, centred.

children.name: Won
children.note: The winning side, end.won_aliens or end.won_humans, the same for every player (no plate for a win or a loss since ui-2.0.0). ToyTextOnDanger on the cops' ground.

children.name: Reason
children.note: Why the round ended, from the host's reason id (#208), in the dim text: end.reason.all_tasks with the round's time (m:ss), end.reason.time_up, or end.reason.cops. An unknown reason hides it.

children.name: Back
children.note: 72 px from the bottom (the target's 48 x 1.5), dim. Counts 3, 2, 1 once a second; at 0 everyone is back on the ship, the lobby (#212).
